notes.title: Demo Update V2.10
notes.content:
[h1][b]Dwarfs Descent – Demo V2.10

Game Updates[/b][/h1][list][*][p][b]Removed Caved-In Spawn X Decal[/b]
Decal removed from spawn area.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Gameplay / Level Design[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Random Start Cave Spawn Adjustment[/b]
Moved random start cave spawns slightly to the right to reduce lantern clipping.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Starting Rubble Quest Spawn Timing[/b]
Spawned the starting rubble quest earlier to avoid visibility issues when the player can already see the area.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mine Exit Sign Overhaul[/b]

Fixed arrows getting stuck in destructible boxes after breaking.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Radiation Microwave Effects on Arrows[/b]

Fixed issue where two meshes were being used for the bow string.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Visual & FX Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Cave-In Particle Effect[/b]
Added new particle effect for when a cave-in hits the ground.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]UI / HUD Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Updated Main Menu[/b]
New mine exit signs now featured in the main menu.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo update V2.03
notes.content:

Changelog:
[/b][/u]

- Added new loot item : Weapon Repair Kit

- Added Random Enemy spawns to Level 1

- Added an idle camera movement

- Added Crouching Idle Animation

- Added sound to all Minecart Levers

- Fixed roof light problem in Dragon level

- Fixed bug with winged sandals playing wrong run animation

- Jump animations updated
